records.jp: 見て見て！　すごいよね、このコンテナ！
records.en_original: Look at this container! Isn't it amazing?
records.en_auxiliary: Look at this container! Isn't it amazing?
records.en: Look at this container! Isn't it amazing?

records.jp: おかげでいろいろ蓄えて置けるようになったんだ。<CR>作ってよかった！
records.en_original: I'm glad we made it. Now we have storage space for all kinds of stuff!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad we made it. Now we have storage space for all kinds of stuff!
records.en: Thanks to it, we can store all sorts of things.<CR>I'm glad we made it!

records.jp: やりすぎな気もするけど……でも、せっかくなら<CR>物資はさらに充実させたいところね
records.en_original: It seems like overkill to me... But we might as well stock up on supplies.
records.en_auxiliary: It seems like overkill to me... But we might as well stock up on supplies.
records.en: It may be overdoing it... But since we've gone this far,<CR>I'd like to improve our stockpile even further.

records.jp: えっ！？
records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: そんなに足りない！？<CR>わりと貯めたつもりなんだけど
records.en_original: We still don't have enough?! I thought I had our bases covered.
records.en_auxiliary: We still don't have enough?! I thought I had our bases covered.
records.en: We don't have enough?!<CR>I thought we'd stored quite a lot.

records.jp: ごめんなさい。そんな意味じゃなくて……
records.en_original: Sorry, that's not what I meant...
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, that's not what I meant...
records.en: Sorry, that's not what I meant...

records.jp: 必要なものは揃っているけど、<CR>更に充実させておいた方が安心だから
records.en_original: We have all the necessities, but it might be a good idea to get more just to be on the safe side.
records.en_auxiliary: We have all the necessities, but it might be a good idea to get more just to be on the safe side.
records.en: We have all the necessities,<CR>but it might be a good idea to get more just to be on the safe side.

records.jp: やっぱそうかー。<CR>もうちょい増やしといた方がいいかー
records.en_original: You might be right. We could use a little bit more.
records.en_auxiliary: You might be right. We could use a little bit more.
records.en: So that's how it is.<CR>We should add a little more.

records.jp: かなり充実しているとは思うけれど、<CR>備えあれば憂いなしって言うしね
records.en_original: We have plenty already, but like they say, you can never be too prepared.
records.en_auxiliary: We have plenty already, but like they say, you can never be too prepared.
records.en: We have plenty already, but like they say,<CR>you can never be too prepared.

records.jp: 現状、何が起きても不思議じゃないし、<CR>備えはいくらあっても無駄にはならないから
records.en_original: You never know what might happen here. We should be ready for anything.
records.en_auxiliary: You never know what might happen here. We should be ready for anything.
records.en: You never know what might happen here.<CR>We should be ready for anything.

records.jp: さすが美弦さんだなぁ。<CR>私、いっぱい増えたって安心しきってたよ
records.en_original: That's the Mio I know. I was happy just having this much.
records.en_auxiliary: That's the Mio I know. I was happy just having this much.
records.en: That's Mio-san for you.<CR>I completely relaxed once I saw how much we'd accumulated.

records.jp: 私の性格的なものかもしれないけれど
records.en_original: It might just be the way that I am.
records.en_auxiliary: It might just be the way that I am.
records.en: It might just be the way that I am.

records.jp: そういえば、美弦さんって……
records.en_original: Now that I think of it, Mio...
records.en_auxiliary: Now that I think of it, Mio...
records.en: Now that I think of it, Mio-san...

records.jp: コレクターだったっけ。<CR>綺麗なものを集めてるって……
records.en_original: You're a collector, right? I heard you collect pretty things...
records.en_auxiliary: You're a collector, right? I heard you collect pretty things...
records.en: You're a collector, right?<CR>I heard you collect pretty things...

records.jp: コレクターなんて大層なものじゃないわ。<CR>本当にささやかなもの
records.en_original: I wouldn't call myself a collector, really, I just like holding on to little things.
records.en_auxiliary: I wouldn't call myself a collector, really, I just like holding on to little things.
records.en: Collector is too grand a word.<CR>It's really only something modest.

records.jp: 綺麗だなと思ったものを見つけたら、<CR>取っておいているだけよ
records.en_original: Like things I find that I think are pretty.
records.en_auxiliary: Like things I find that I think are pretty.
records.en: I simply keep things I<CR>find beautiful.

records.jp: 私、美弦さんが綺麗だって思ったもの、<CR>見たいなぁ
records.en_original: I wanna see your collection of pretty things, Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: I wanna see your collection of pretty things, Mio.
records.en: I want to see the things you thought were beautiful,<CR>Mio-san.

records.jp: 溜め込み気質だった！<CR>自分の気持ちとかも
records.en_original: You're a total hoarder! You keep everything stashed away, just like your feelings!
records.en_auxiliary: You're a total hoarder! You keep everything stashed away, just like your feelings!
records.en: You really are the type to keep things bottled up!<CR>Your feelings too.

records.jp: そ、それは、その……はぁ
records.en_original: Th-that's...it's just... *sigh*
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's...it's just... *sigh*
records.en: Th-that's... well... Sigh.

records.jp: 私の悪い癖ね。<CR>コンテナもこれで充分なのかもしれない
records.en_original: It's a bad habit of mine. I suppose this container is full enough already.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a bad habit of mine. I suppose this container is full enough already.
records.en: It's a bad habit of mine.<CR>Maybe this container is full enough already.

records.jp: え！？　ちょっとからかったら落ち込んだ！？<CR>あ、でも、落ち込んだってことは……
records.en_original: Hey, I'm just joking around! I didn't think I'd hit a nerve...
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, I'm just joking around! I didn't think I'd hit a nerve...
records.en: What?! I teased you a little and you became depressed?!<CR>Ah, but if you're depressed...

records.jp: 私に気持ち、見せてくれてるんだ
records.en_original: But I guess if you're upset, it means you're showing me your feelings.
records.en_auxiliary: But I guess if you're upset, it means you're showing me your feelings.
records.en: It means you're showing me your feelings.

records.jp: 私、美弦さんのこと<CR>もっとたくさん知りたいなぁ
records.en_original: I want to get to know you more, Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to get to know you more, Mio.
records.en: I want to get to know you more,<CR>Mio-san.

records.jp: 私のことなんて、そう面白くもないと思うけど？
records.en_original: I don't think I'm all that interesting.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think I'm all that interesting.
records.en: I don't think I'm all that interesting.

records.jp: もー！　面白いか面白くないかじゃないんだって！<CR>もっと美弦さんと仲良くなりたいだけだしー！
records.en_original: Ugh! I don't care if you're interesting or not! I just want to be closer to you!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh! I don't care if you're interesting or not! I just want to be closer to you!
records.en: Come on! It isn't about whether you're interesting!<CR>I just want to get closer to you, Mio-san!

records.jp: 私と仲良く、って……どうして？
records.en_original: Be closer to me...? But why?
records.en_auxiliary: Be closer to me...? But why?
records.en: Be closer to me...? But why?

records.jp: うー。もーいーもん！　美弦さんのバカー！
records.en_original: Ugh... Never mind! You dummy!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh... Never mind! You dummy!
records.en: Fine! Mio-san, you idiot!

records.jp: え？　愛央？<CR>私、何かひどいことを言った？
records.en_original: Huh? Ao? Did something I said upset you?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Ao? Did something I said upset you?
records.en: What? Ao?<CR>Did I say something terrible?

records.jp: 私は単純に、美弦さん好きだから、<CR>もっと仲良くなりたいーってだけだから！
records.en_original: I like you, Mio. That's why I want to be closer to you! That's all!
records.en_auxiliary: I like you, Mio. That's why I want to be closer to you! That's all!
records.en: I like you, Mio-san.<CR>That's why I want to be closer to you! That's all!

records.jp: そんなの、理由なんかないよ！
records.en_original: I don't have any other reason!
records.en_auxiliary: I don't have any other reason!
records.en: There's no reason for something like that!

records.jp: 理由がなくても……いいんだ……
records.en_original: I see... There doesn't have to be a reason.
records.en_auxiliary: I see... There doesn't have to be a reason.
records.en: It's all right... even without a reason...

records.jp: 美弦さんは、理由がないと誰かと仲良くなったり<CR>しないの？
records.en_original: Don't you ever get close to people without having a reason, Mio?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you ever get close to people without having a reason, Mio?
records.en: Don't you ever get close to people without having a reason,<CR>Mio-san?

records.jp: ……ごめんなさい。私が無神経だったわ。<CR>そうね。親しくなるのに理由は要らないわね
records.en_original: ...I'm sorry. I was being insensitive. You're right, you don't need a reason to be close to someone.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm sorry. I was being insensitive. You're right, you don't need a reason to be close to someone.
records.en: ...I'm sorry. I was being insensitive.<CR>You're right, you don't need a reason to be close to someone.

records.jp: 美弦さんって、いろんなキレイが詰まってるから、<CR>私、大好きだし憧れてるし……
records.en_original: You're just so full of all kinds of beauty, Mio. I've always liked you. And admired you...
records.en_auxiliary: You're just so full of all kinds of beauty, Mio. I've always liked you. And admired you...
records.en: You're filled with so many kinds of beauty, Mio-san.<CR>I love you, and I admire you...

records.jp: そのキレイって、私が勝手に見つけたもので、<CR>要は美弦さん好きだなーってことで……
records.en_original: Not that I only care about your looks! What I'm trying to say is...I really like you, Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: Not that I only care about your looks! What I'm trying to say is...I really like you, Mio.
records.en: That 'beauty' is just something I happened to see in you.<CR>Basically... I really like you, Mio-san.

records.jp: そういうのって、理由にならない？
records.en_original: Isn't that reason enough?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't that reason enough?
records.en: Isn't that reason enough?

records.jp: 私が綺麗かどうかはともかく……<CR>そんな風に言ってくれて、ありがとう
records.en_original: I don't know if I'm beautiful...but thanks for saying so.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if I'm beautiful...but thanks for saying so.
records.en: Whether or not I'm beautiful...<CR>Thank you for saying that.

records.jp: 私も……愛央のことを、もっと知りたい
records.en_original: I want to get to know you better too, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to get to know you better too, Ao.
records.en: I want to get to know you better too, Ao.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
